details.description: Build and maintain the communication pipelines that power all external marketing and servicing messages to members on a fintech platform, using Java, Spring Boot, Databricks, Spark, and Python.
Own end-to-end delivery of member communication workflows, from large-scale data processing in Databricks and Spark to message dispatch through Java and Spring Boot services.

Developed and maintained data pipelines processing high volumes of healthcare data to power customer journey campaigns, across a platform of \textbf{200+} Java Spring Boot microservices (Angular 18, Azure Functions, Adobe Experience Platform, Kafka, and Databricks).
Delivered timely, accurate campaign data for business-critical healthcare journeys operating on high-volume datasets.
Architected, developed, and oversaw end-to-end technical implementation of the FlipItMoney App, serving a user base of \textbf{1.2 million} users.
Implemented the full technical stack of the company hands-on throughout the \textbf{2.5-year} tenure.
Raised a total of \textbf{\$2.87 million} in funding, with \textbf{Kotak Securities} among the investors.
Managed a team of \textbf{9} engineers (junior and senior) across Backend, Frontend, and Infrastructure.
Architected and built the Xcelerate application for TCS from scratch as a Full Stack Java Developer, revolutionizing the way \textbf{400,000} employees accessed and utilized crucial resources.
Migrated a legacy application, saving the team \textbf{1 year} of revamp effort.
